legend.no module: the module isn't one js2wasi3 ships: importing it is a build error

legend.n/a: not an API of a running program

rows.api: append {boolean} Whether the stream is appending to the file or truncating it.
contentMode {string} The type of data that can be written to the stream. Supported values are 'utf8' or 'buffer'. **Default**: 'utf8'.
fd {number} The file descriptor that is being written to.
file {string} The file that is being written to.
fsync {boolean} Whether the stream is performing a fs.fsyncSync() after every write operation.

maxLength {number} The maximum length of the internal buffer. If a write operation would cause the buffer to exceed maxLength, the data written is dropped and a drop event is emitted with the dropped data.
minLength {number} The minimum length of the internal buffer that is required to be full before flushing.
mkdir {boolean} Whether the stream should ensure that the directory for the dest file exists. If true, it will create the directory if it does not exist. **Default**: false.
mode {number|string} The mode of the file that is being written to.
periodicFlush {number} The number of milliseconds between flushes. If set to 0, no periodic flushes will be performed.
sync {boolean} Whether the stream is writing synchronously or asynchronously.
writing {boolean} Whether the stream is currently writing data to the file.
